messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Re: Can R/qtl use same data form as Qgene?
parts: > 1. Can R/qtl generate linkage groups by itself?

While the main purpose of R/qtl is for QTL mapping, we have recently
added a function for dividing markers into linkage groups on the basis
of pairwise marker linkages (formLinkageGroups) and a function for
ordering markers within a linkage group, de novo (orderMarkers).
There are also functions for exploring neighboring marker orders
(ripple) and for estimating inter-marker distances for a fixed marker
order (est.map).

http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/formLinkageGroups.html
http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/orderMarkers.html
http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/ripple.html
http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/est_map.html

> 2. Formating data is a pain in mapping and QTL analysis. Can R/qtl use
> formated dataset which was used in Qgene or other software such as
> MapQTL?

We can't read data in Qgene or MapQTL formats, but there are a variety
of other formats (including Mapmaker, MapManager and QTL Cartographer)
that can be used. The function for importing data is read.cross.

http://www.rqtl.org/manual/html/read.cross.html
